from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. Load model.stl and parts_1..4.stl
model_mesh = trimesh.load("/app/output/model.stl")
part_meshes = [trimesh.load(f"/app/output/parts/parts_{i}.stl") for i in range(1, 5)]

print("=== MESH & BOUNDING BOX SUMMARY ===")
print("model.stl:", {
    "watertight": model_mesh.is_watertight,
    "bounds": model_mesh.bounds.round(3).tolist(),
    "extents": model_mesh.extents.round(3).tolist(),
    "volume": round(float(model_mesh.volume), 2),
    "vertices": len(model_mesh.vertices),
    "faces": len(model_mesh.faces),
})

sum_verts = 0
sum_faces = 0
for i, pm in enumerate(part_meshes, 1):

    sum_verts += len(pm.vertices)
    sum_faces += len(pm.faces)
    print(f"parts_{i}.stl:", {

        "is_volume": pm.is_volume,
        "bounds": pm.bounds.round(3).tolist(),
        "extents": pm.extents.round(3).tolist(),
        "centroid": pm.centroid.round(3).tolist(),
        "volume": round(float(pm.volume), 2),
        "vertices": len(pm.vertices),
        "faces": len(pm.faces),
    })

print(f"Sum of parts volume: {sum_vol:.2f} vs model.stl volume: {model_mesh.volume:.2f}")
print(f"Sum of parts vertices/faces: {sum_verts}/{sum_faces} vs model.stl: {len(model_mesh.vertices)}/{len(model_mesh.faces)}")

# 2. Clearance & Kinematics
np.random.seed(42)
pts = [trimesh.sample.sample_surface(pm, 150000)[0] for pm in part_meshes]
trees = [cKDTree(pt) for pt in pts]

joints_cfg = [
    ("joint_1", 0, 1, [-4.0, 0.0, 0.0], 19.5, 2.6, 3.1, 6.0),
    ("joint_2", 1, 2, [-19.5, 0.0, 0.0], 17.5, 2.4, 2.9, 5.5),
    ("joint_3", 2, 3, [-34.0, 0.0, 0.0], 15.5, 2.2, 2.7, 5.0),
]

for jname, ia, ib, center, H, r_pin, r_bore, z_mid in joints_cfg:
    pA, pB = part_meshes[ia], part_meshes[ib]
    dists, _ = trees[ia].query(pts[ib])
    min_3d = float(dists.min())

    # Measure radial clearance in horizontal slice at z = z_mid
    slice_A = pA.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, z_mid], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    slice_B = pB.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, z_mid], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    pts_sA = slice_A.vertices[:, :2] - np.array(center[:2])
    pts_sB = slice_B.vertices[:, :2] - np.array(center[:2])
    rA = np.linalg.norm(pts_sA, axis=1)
    rB = np.linalg.norm(pts_sB, axis=1)
    meas_r_pin = float(rA[rA < r_pin + 0.3].max())
    meas_r_bore = float(rB[rB < r_bore + 0.3].min())
    meas_rad_clear = meas_r_bore - meas_r_pin

    # Measure rotation limits (1 deg steps)
    max_pos = 0
    for ang in range(1, 60):
        b_rot = pB.copy()
        b_rot.apply_transform(trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.radians(ang), [0, 0, 1], center))
        inter = trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_rot], engine="manifold")
        if not inter.is_empty and inter.volume > 0.005:
            break
        max_pos = ang
    max_neg = 0
    for ang in range(-1, -60, -1):
        b_rot = pB.copy()
        b_rot.apply_transform(trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.radians(ang), [0, 0, 1], center))
        inter = trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_rot], engine="manifold")
        if not inter.is_empty and inter.volume > 0.005:
            break
        max_neg = ang

    # Measure axial retention (+Z and -Z)
    dz_pos = None
    dz_neg = None
    for dz in np.round(np.linspace(0.05, 2.0, 40), 3):
        b_p = pB.copy(); b_p.apply_translation([0, 0, dz])
        ip = trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_p], engine="manifold")
        if not ip.is_empty and ip.volume > 0.005 and dz_pos is None:
            dz_pos = float(dz)
        b_n = pB.copy(); b_n.apply_translation([0, 0, -dz])
        in_ = trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_n], engine="manifold")
        if not in_.is_empty and in_.volume > 0.005 and dz_neg is None:
            dz_neg = float(-dz)

    b_p15 = pB.copy(); b_p15.apply_translation([0, 0, 1.5])
    vol_p15 = float(trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_p15], engine="manifold").volume)
    b_m15 = pB.copy(); b_m15.apply_translation([0, 0, -1.5])
    vol_m15 = float(trimesh.boolean.intersection([pA, b_m15], engine="manifold").volume)

    print(f"{jname}: r_pin={meas_r_pin:.3f}, r_bore={meas_r_bore:.3f}, rad_clear={meas_rad_clear:.4f}mm, min_3d={min_3d:.4f}mm, rot=[{max_neg}, +{max_pos}] deg, axial_lock=[{dz_neg}, +{dz_pos}]mm, vol@+-1.5mm=({vol_m15:.2f}, {vol_p15:.2f})mm^3")

# 3. Plot XZ longitudinal cross-section at Y=0 and XY cross-section at Z=5.5mm
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8))
colors = ["#2b5c8f", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77"]
labels = ["parts_1 (Body)", "parts_2 (Tail 1)", "parts_3 (Tail 2)", "parts_4 (Tail 3)"]

# Top plot: XZ section at Y=0
ax = axes[0]
for i, pm in enumerate(part_meshes):
    sec = pm.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, 0], plane_normal=[0, 1, 0])
    if sec is not None:
        for entity in sec.entities:
            pts_sec = sec.vertices[entity.points]
            ax.plot(pts_sec[:, 0], pts_sec[:, 2], color=colors[i], lw=1.5, label=labels[i] if entity == sec.entities[0] else "")
ax.set_title("Longitudinal Cross-Section at Centerline Y = 0 mm (Showing 3 Z-Axis Pin Joints & Conical Axial Retention)")
ax.set_xlabel("X (mm)")
ax.set_ylabel("Z (mm)")
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="upper left")

# Bottom plot: XY section at Z = 5.5 mm
ax2 = axes[1]
for i, pm in enumerate(part_meshes):
    sec = pm.section(plane_origin=[0, 0, 5.5], plane_normal=[0, 0, 1])
    if sec is not None:
        for entity in sec.entities:

            ax2.plot(pts_sec[:, 0], pts_sec[:, 1], color=colors[i], lw=1.5)
ax2.set_title("Horizontal Cross-Section at Z = 5.5 mm (Showing Cylindrical Pins, Bores, and 0.50 mm Radial Clearances)")
ax2.set_xlabel("X (mm)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Y (mm)")
ax2.set_aspect("equal")
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/tmp/cross_sections.png", dpi=150)
print("Saved /tmp/cross_sections.png")
'
